mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.space WHERE id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND type='PERSONAL') ELSE false END
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.capability WHERE id=#{capability} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND kind='SKILL')

SELECT DISTINCT ON(c.id) c.id AS capability_id,v.id AS version_id,v.version_number,p.name,p.description,s.state,s.revision FROM pf.capability c JOIN pf.capability_version v ON v.space_id=c.space_id AND v.owner_user_id=c.owner_user_id AND v.capability_id=c.id JOIN pf.skill_package_version p ON p.space_id=v.space_id AND p.owner_user_id=v.owner_user_id AND p.capability_id=v.capability_id AND p.version_id=v.id JOIN pf.capability_version_status s ON s.space_id=v.space_id AND s.owner_user_id=v.owner_user_id AND s.capability_id=v.capability_id AND s.version_id=v.id WHERE c.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND c.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND c.kind='SKILL' AND c.id>#{after} ORDER BY c.id,v.version_number DESC LIMIT #{limit}
